title: Clearly Optimized
description: Clearly Optimized: Maximum frames, minimum lag. Fabric, perfected.
body:
# ⚡️ Clearly Optimized ✨

**Clearly Optimized** is a lightweight performance pack designed to maximize your FPS and minimize system overhead without changing the Vanilla feel.

---

### 🚀 **What’s Inside?**

* **Elite Rendering:** Powered by **Sodium** and **Iris**, providing massive FPS gains and built-in shader support.
* **Instant Response:** **ImmediatelyFast** and **BadOptimizations** eliminate UI and entity rendering bottlenecks.
* **Deep Logic Tweaks:** **Lithium** and **C2ME** optimize game physics and world generation (chunk loading) for a smoother feel.
* **Memory Efficiency:** **FerriteCore** and **Noisium** significantly reduce RAM usage and speed up world loading.
* **Visual Refinement:** Includes **Zoomify** (zoom), **LambDynamicLights**, and **Entity Culling** for better visuals at a lower cost.

---

### 🛠️ **Performance breakdown**

| Feature | Mods Included |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Graphics** | Sodium, Iris, MoreCulling, ScalableLux |
| **Logic/CPU** | Lithium, C2ME, BadOptimizations |
| **Memory** | FerriteCore, Noisium |
| **Quality of Life** | Zoomify, ModMenu, Sodium Extra, Reese's Options |

---

### 📥 **Quick Start**
1. **Install:** Download and install to your launcher.
2. **Launch:** Uses **Fabric Loader 0.18.6** on **Minecraft 26.1**.
3. **Play:** Enjoy a lag-free experience out of the box, no configuration required.

> *"Clearly Optimized: Because the only thing you should notice is how smooth your game feels."*
